InitActions subscribes using source faction (BirdsTurnStarted or PigsTurnStarted). Init uses dictionary key presence for invoker, first_target and cleanse_target flags. Heal chooses source modified health for invoker, original selected target health for first_target, or each target health otherwise. Additional healing percentage applies only to selected target; cleanse chance and target-only cleansing are separate.

Switch at 0x10c4e21 dispatches SoundParameterType 0 to looping=true (+0x17), 1 to one-shot=true (+0x14), 2 to primary music/source (+0x15/+0x2c), 3 to FadeTime (+0x20) from parameter Value, 4 to secondary music/source (+0x16/+0x2c). Boolean flags use presence even when Value=0. Jump table destinations verified from ELF bytes.
Nonempty AssetNames selects UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, Count) then indexed name. Empty list returns NameId. It does not select by modulo elapsed time or first asset.

Checks SoundLookup.ContainsKey at 0x10c5a39, skips Add when present, so duplicate IDs retain the first definition. Both duplicate rows still join channel lists and run Init. Shipped SkillFX_Gen_Support_Magic has two rows with volumes 0.5 and 1.0.

PlayMusic routes to PlaySound on primary music source GameObject. Start obtains the audio provider for AssetPrioritiy, picks GetAssetName and GetAudioClip, uses one-shot branch or normal AudioSource loop/volume/clip/play with a music fade coroutine path. Complete fades, channel gain and trigger behavior remain unfinished.

Computes Mathf.Round(base + (level - 1) * ((perLevel / 100f) * base)) in single precision. Native inlined rounding branches compare fractional halves and odd integer parts for ties-to-even. ELF GOT literals 100f, +1/-1 and +0.5/-0.5 verified. PerLevel fields are percentages, not flat increments.

Chooses quality-percent list[quality] or last entry; rounds percentage-of-base level growth first. Percentage quality is Round((((qualityPercent/quality)/100f)*roundedBase)*quality), zero at quality <=0, then Max with quality when qualityPercent>0 else 0. Adds roundedBase, integer quality*StatPerQuality and that percentage bonus. Ancient adds total*AncientEquipmentStatsBoost/100; positive enchantment then adds current total*enchantment.StatsBoost/100. Returns float without final rounding.

Looks up ExperienceMasteryBalancingData by Level_{ClassItemData.Level:00}, returns StatBonus/100f * class-independent stat. Class-independent includes the corresponding gear. Legacy ClassItemBalancingData per-mastery fields are not used by these getters.

Uses default-inventory InitializingLevel when nonzero, otherwise supplied bird level, to GenerateLoot. Rewards that loot with quality argument 0 at 0x6c28f0 and source 4; default hand identities come from the exact InventoryBalancingData dictionary. Full loot/recruitment lifecycle remains unfinished.

OnExperienceChanged resolves ExperienceLevelBalancingData for current Level_{level:00}; absent current row returns without adding XP. Adds delta to PlayerData.Experience and compares >= row.Experience at 0x703907, calling ApplyLevelUp once. ApplyLevelUp subtracts neededExperience from residual XP at 0x703a1d and increments player level at 0x703a68. Updates next cost only when next row exists (0x703bee), and sets each owned bird level. Supplied rows Level_01..99 imply terminal 100; table costs sum123520. Full fractional XP, surplus UI event choreography and level-up loot remain unfinished.

Pig defeat loot is lazily generated from repeated field13 root map at pig level. Recursive table generation caps depth at10; type1 weighted uses eligible rows and inclusive cumulative boundary, type2 inventory ignores level/probability filters, type0 probability uses inclusive comparison. Entry selection consumes Random.Range(0,Span+1), clamps negative values, propagates nonnegative level delta and recurses into nested tables. Existing resource IDs merge before ancient_ normalization; normalized key collisions can throw. All26 tables reachable from140 imported pig maps are weighted; three direct-resource roots are valid. Wheel and forced-wheel selection remain unimplemented; Unity global RNG order remains provisional.

XP factor uses pigLevel-playerLevel. Equal difference returns1; otherwise first ascending ExperienceScaling.Difference >= difference supplies XpModifier/100; no upper bound returns1. Per-pig XP is multiplied then truncated with cvttss2si. On final wave with no living pigs, BattleBalancing.BonusLoot experience is added after scaling, once using battle manager+0x90 guard; may create XP item when absent. RewardLootGetInputCopy receives battle ControllerInventory+0x78. Rust settles once per recorded defeat at action boundaries, retaining loss/retreat XP; native death coroutine order and level-up fighter refresh remain unfinished.

World map setup stores PlayerGameData.InventoryGameData at BattleStartGameData+0x1c. GenerateBattle copies it to BattleGameData.ControllerInventory+0x78, and start level+0x30 to battle controller level+0x7c. OnControllerLevelUp assigns new controller level. This statically confirms direct player inventory routing rather than a win-only XP stash; full retreat and runtime UI/rollback comparison remains unverified.

Bird model level event raises combatant LevelChanged then RaiseBuffsChanged. BuffsChanged marks attack cache+0x50 and health cache+0x44 dirty. ModifiedHealth recomputes from dynamic bird base and health modifiers/perk, writes result into current-health storage+0x60 at0x1603ac3, then adds TemporaryHealth+0x3c to cached maximum+0x40. Thus level refresh indirectly refills health; merely tracing level callback and current-health clamp misses this side effect. IsAlive checks positive current health; IsParticipating separately rejects knockout and checks participation flag+0xac. LevelUp effect waits on UI level-up state/pacing, spawns configured LevelUp/LevelUpFX and finally dispatches ICombatant slot104 RaiseBuffsChanged, not slot13 RefreshHealth. Rust refreshes all battle birds with original base growth/captured skin, refills HP and retains explicit knockout/actions/effects; full temporary-health/perks, exact lazy getter/coroutine order and revival lifecycle remain unfinished.

Single revive obtains GameConstants.ReviveSingleBirdsRequirement and consumes requirement before calling ReviveBird. Original requirement row is resource lucky_coin amount5; all-party10/PvP15 retained separately. ReviveBird requests100 percent health at0x9f54ce, then ICombatant slot97 set_KnockOutOnDefeat(true), so repeated paid revives are possible. ReviveCombatant computes ModifiedHealth*percentage/100-CurrentHealth, queues HealDamage (slot112), runs HealCurrentTurn, clears IsKnockedOut (slot89), restores initiative membership and recalculates. Bird ctor defaults KnockOutOnDefeat true; knockout callback turns it off until revive rearms it. PlayKnockoutAnim selects KnockedOut. PlayReviveAnim first recognizes BirdGameData and selects KnockedOutEnd; non-bird branch uses ICharacter.IsPvPBird before falling back to Resurrection. All five bird clips verified in runtime library. Rust single revive uses existing shared gold wallet, full health, separate knockout state, retained used action and recovery presentation; native separate currencies, all-party/PvP/free/tutorial flow, full initiative, perks and trigger timing remain unfinished. Metadata usage-kind1 slot GOT+0x45918 independently resolves native CLASS type definition4486 ABH.GameDatas.BirdGameData, confirming the first PlayReviveAnim branch.

Revive click selects normal ReviveBirdsRequirement or PvP requirement. PlayerData.FirstReviveUsed is checked at0xa4ac99; when false a copied requirement is created with Value0 at0xa4ace8/call0xa4acf0, retaining resource/type. Requirement consumption must succeed before FirstReviveUsed=true at0xa4aebe/call0xa4aec6; calls ReviveAllBirds and saves player data. EnterReviveButton applies the same free-first rule to displayed cost. ReviveAllBirds loops faction0 with ReviveCombatant100%, clears ActedThisTurn for both factions (ICombatant slot127), StartedHisTurn for faction1 (slot129), then clears/restarts initiative. No enemy-health reset or wave reload in this path. Rust v5 persists the entitlement, backs up v4 before mutation, restores all birds/reset turn completion in the existing battle and retains drop ledger. Exact initiative/coroutine/trigger/perk flow, separate native currency inventory and original popup/countdown remain unfinished.

OnAddMasteryItem first requires inventory value unlock_mastery_badge>0; direct ClassItem.AddMastery separately requires that badge item exist. Class ItemValue is signed int Value; AddMastery adds amount, loops while rank<MasteryMaxRank and Value>=current required cost, subtracts/clamps0, increments class rank, updates ExperienceForNextLevel and recomputes next cost at0x6cdbec. Reaching maximum clears residual Value. MasteryMaxRank counts ExperienceMasteryBalancingData rows (100 bundled); rank0 cost sentinel10000000, rank>=maximum cost i32::MAX; normal cost uses current Level_XX.Experience, not OldExperience/AncientExperience. Current mastery selects faction0 ICombatant.IsParticipating (slot86) and !ICharacter.IsNPC (slot20), then awards each participant current class; quantity is not split. AddMastery(c) resolves owner by class RestrictedBirdId; some legacy rows have empty restriction, retained as data for later ownership/routing work. Source offer_star_reward_02 rewards unlock_mastery_badge and requires star_collection>=100 with one-time acquired-reward condition. Core evaluator/recipient/stat-helper foundation implemented separately; live unlock/star scoring, owned class persistence, delivery/fallback, exact timing and callbacks remain unfinished.

CompleteHotSpot compares stored stars and only writes an improved StarCount (get0xab48ee, compare0xab48f3, set0xab4922). Live Rust integration now maps the source100-star badge gate to highest-star collection, applies current-party drops once to participating captured classes, validates restricted-bird ownership and shares rank state across skins. v7 stores rank and residual points by stable class ID, validates ownership/range/canonical residual, initializes absent legacy mastery to rank1 and preserves exact v6 before changed writes. Chooses one integer Random.Range(0, entryCount) start even if amount <= 0. For amount positive, processes entries[(start+i)%entryCount] in order. Each goes through ProcessLootEntry; no level eligibility or weight/probability selection at wheel level. The selected start is written through the caller reference.
Uses caller-provided referenced integer start, then consecutive wrapped slots, with no random starting-slot draw. Entry quantity/span RNG still runs.

Verified relative jump table at GOT-0x64f9cc: kind0 ->0x57c6f5 probabilities, 1 ->0x57c743 weights, 2 ->0x57c78e inventory, 3 ->0x57c7df wheel/forced flag, 4 ->0x57c83e forced wheel. Kind3 uses forced flag at ebp+0x30; kind4 always forced. ProcessLootEntry recursive call clears preview/forced flags. Wheel processors pass a separate initially-zero local wheel-index ref to ProcessLootEntry, so a forced root start is not inherited by nested wheels.

At 0x4fee84 passes BattleEndGameData.m_BattlePerformanceStars (+0x20) as GenerateLoot amount, m_Level (+0x44) as level, and ref m_ThrownWheelIndex (+0x28), then stores resulting wheel map at endData+0x10. Bonus fields are enabled only when greater than zero. Stun callback tests ICombatant slot123 get_IsStunned and multiplies incoming float by m_DamageBonusVsStun/100 without integer rounding (0xee9ae2..0xee9b78). Debuff callback reads slot49 get_CurrrentEffects, walks values and enables one multiplier when any BattleEffectGameData.m_EffectType (+0x10) equals2, then returns incomingFloat*(m_DamageVsDebuff/100) at0xeeaa98..0xeeaac1. Other condition multipliers in36205 are successive independent checks, not else-if; runtime still lacks corresponding status types. Whole-pipeline defense/hook timing/fractional stats remain unfinished.

Init appends the healing delegate to ActionsOnDamageDealt at AttackSkillTemplate+0x70. DoAction invokes that list per hit at0xeb962c, passing the integer return of DealDamageFromCurrentTurn converted to float, not HP-removed min(health,damage). DealDamageFromCurrentTurn normalizes through Mathf.RoundToInt and retains its normalized amount through the ordinary overkill path (fatal-trigger modification is separate). Healing callback requires positive incoming damage, selects same CombatantFaction (ICombatant slot47), then CurrentHealth>0 (slot31); it calls HealDamage (slot112) with incomingDamage*m_Percent/100 and HealCurrentTurn. Knockout participation is not the eligibility predicate. Native HealDamage accumulates a float at +0x84; full queued healing/trigger/float-HP behavior remains unfinished in the integer runtime.

Init appends an ActionsAfterDamageDealt delegate at +0x6c. Framework invokes per participating target with nonzero accumulated normalized damage or explicit effect/no-damage flags. ShareableActionPart always draws UnityEngine.Random.value at0x149244b and skips only when draw>m_StunChance/100 (inclusive success), including 0/100 thresholds. Duration is m_StunDuration(+0x9c). Presence of chance_to_stun_vs_wet sets m_StunVsWet(+0xa1); this branch requires current effects key WaterBomb and returns before RNG if absent. Freeze/tentacle presence flags, art, cleanup and wet application still need runtime reconstruction; do not substitute poison/stun for WaterBomb.

RoundToInt converts input float to double. On exact fractional+0.5/-0.5 it tests integral parity and increments/decrements only an odd integer, then converts with cvttsd2si: ties to even. Verified x86 GOT-relative doubles: -0x6b2884=-0.5, -0x6b2894=+0.5, -0x64f9b4=-1, -0x6b28a4=+1. Native NormalizeDamage delegates to this routine. combat_math.rs models the finite rounding and x86 invalid/out-of-range integer-indefinite result. Runtime primary attack/buff/conditional/defense factors now stay float until this boundary; unrelated modifier trigger ordering and initial fractional stat/HP storage remain unfinished.

Reads ICombatant slot39 get_SummedHealPerTurn; normalizes at0x50a2df, then conditionally applies healing trigger IDs15,10,35 with additional NormalizeDamage calls. Adds normalized integer to CurrentHealth at0x50a4c5..0x50a4cb and writes it through slot32. Clears summed-heal with slot40 at0x50a59d and returns the normalized amount (not HP actually restored). HealAlly calls with its first boolean true: a nonpositive initial normalized amount skips application and clears the queue. Basic ordinary queue/normalization/drain is now implemented; optional flags, healing trigger modifiers/PvP/perks and complete fractional HP remain unfinished.

Original Shaman/Witch Doctor curses now apply to surviving damaged targets from either faction. Native inclusive chance draw retained, including0/100 after the shared damage/participation gate. Each curse multiplies running heal by (100-reduction)/100; initial queued heal and completed trigger pass normalize separately with ties-to-even. Curse classification, cleanse/purge, recast and source-turn expiry use the shared effect owner. Tests cover50/70/100%, float stacking, rounding stages and shield/knockout exclusion. Full healing-increase/passive/environmental/consumable/support-trigger/perk ordering, Unity RNG, fractional HP and same-type native dictionary enumeration remain pending.

enemy_ai_observations.fact: ComboInfo stores a selected AiCombo and index initially zero. Native selection reads indexed ComboChain skill, increments the index, checks skill feasibility, and chooses another combo once exhausted. Feasibility skipping and PvP/interrupt paths remain unimplemented.

Sums combo percentages, draws Unity Random.Range(0,total), and selects by cumulative lower bounds in serialized order. Rust uses its own seeded random stream with the same weighted selection structure.

Reads and truncates charge parameter to int. Creates a manual charge effect with that duration, retains target at skill+0x38, and returns true while charging. Existing charge with turns left greater than one increments elapsed manually; at one or less it clears charging and recursively evaluates continuation. Charge modifiers and special interrupt interactions remain unresolved.

Dispatches on PigTargetingBehavior. Metadata enum: None=0, Weakest=1, Strongest=3, bird-specific=11..15, Self=16. Weakest/strongest selector lambdas read ICombatant.get_CurrentHealth (slot31). Other debuff/buff/charging-specific selectors remain separate work.

animation_observations.fact: Copies four supplied Vector3 corner values directly into the mesh vertex array at consecutive indices. Frame corner values are already pivot-adjusted, so the runtime must not subtract the pivot offset again. AnimationEvent_Triggered reads Unity AnimationEvent.intParameter and indexes the trigger frame array before forwarding to AnimationEventTrigger. Event type constants from nested TRIGGER_EVENT_TYPE: UserTrigger0, HideTexture1, ChangeMaterial2, ChangeDepth3, ChangeTexture4, ChangePivot5, ChangeCollider6. FireTextureTrigger handles visibility, material, mesh vertex and UV changes. All2352 decoded Unity events independently agree with SmoothMoves clip index and integer frame.

Base callback compares Movement, Impact and Projectile, spawning VFX/projectiles. AttackSkillTemplate override and coroutine provide additional melee wait evidence in the following observation; full native damage sequencing remains unfinished.

Shipped timeout recovered as1.5 seconds; conditional branch at0xeb6218 overrides with0.4 and its eligibility still requires tracing. Projectile/multihit/support timing remains unfinished.

Update normalizes elapsed time by+0x6c and invokes Finished at completion, evaluates general/per-axis AnimationCurves. Identifying each projectile asset binding and damage callback remains unfinished.

PlayAttackAnim uses Action_Attack_1 if MainHand is absent; otherwise bool useOffhand selects ICharacter.MainHand(slot9) or OffHand(slot10), obtains EquipmentBalancingData.AnimationIndex, plays Action_Attack_<index>, and queues Idle. Current client applies the recovered default pig loadout's index for attack playback; player gear and original weapon sprite swaps remain unfinished.

Normal non-melee path at0xeb6e96 yields full PlayAttackAnimation return length and sets PC9; illusion path at0xeb628a stores duration and yields half, PC7 spawns projectile then yields other half (PC8). Update at0x907d9c tests m_Inverted(+0x70); at0x907da2-0x907de1 swaps sampled X/Y progress, then computes start+(end-start)*progress componentwise. CHMeshSprite passes authored width/height/color/alignment.
